text: CHECKER (infer.rs, all engines): a tuple pattern on a subject whose type is already known binds each component to the element's type, with every numeric leaf a free var that must resolve to some number (any width; Uncertain/Temporal around a number accepted), and checks a nested tuple pattern against its element; a component var given to a fn value is compared as its element leaf (CS2-6). Check-clean run panics such as (a, b) on (1, "s") with b + 1 or str_len(a) are E0102. New refusals of programs that run: a component used as another kind where the value passed through (println of an int component, let s: str = a, a str component == 1; the CS4-3 controls q4, q5, q7, q11, q18, q19; NH-1 (a)), and a dead nested tuple arm on a non-tuple element. Untyped/generic subjects, non-tuple sub-patterns and let/for destructuring are unchanged. The 717 tracked .ax files check with the same exit codes as the base binary.
